principle.causality: The hand is locally braked at impact; pelvis/root inertia overruns for one authored beat, front support then catches the residual momentum, and recovery repays shoulder/limb lag without reverse interpolation.

keys.name: READ_OFFSET
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root quiet but asymmetrically stacked behind rear support.
keys.causal_role: Readable offset stance banks options before commitment.

keys.name: REAR_COIL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis loads down/back while chest counter-rotates.
keys.causal_role: Asymmetric anticipation stores root and shoulder torque.

keys.name: PELVIS_COMMIT_BRIDGE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis crosses neutral before the striking hand claims range.
keys.causal_role: Authored body-before-limb bridge prevents telescoping-arm attack.

keys.name: ENTRY
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root advances one beat; chest follows; hand accelerates last.
keys.causal_role: Directional commitment with visible body ownership.

keys.name: PRECONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root and shoulder are committed before a one-cell target gap.
keys.causal_role: Distinct precontact silhouette preserves readable contact instant.

keys.name: CONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Striking hand reaches fixed target while root remains behind it.
keys.causal_role: Explicit impact/hit-stop candidate; target becomes the local limb brake.

keys.name: LOCAL_REVERSAL_ROOT_OVERRUN
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Hand reverses four cells while pelvis/root continue three cells forward.
keys.causal_role: Core fork: contact reverses the striking limb before body inertia reverses.

keys.name: SHOULDER_COMPRESSION
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Front support arrests root after overrun; chest folds behind the retreating hand.
keys.causal_role: Force transfer becomes body compression rather than reverse interpolation.

keys.name: SUPPORT_CATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Base widens and root drops; front leg services the next action.
keys.causal_role: Support catches residual forward momentum after local limb reversal.

keys.name: LIMB_LAG_RECOIL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis begins recoil; striking hand remains late and low.
keys.causal_role: Secondary limb lag keeps recoil from reading as mirrored playback.

keys.name: TORSO_OVERSHOOT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Chest overshoots behind pelvis while rear support reacquires.
keys.causal_role: Authored recoil overshoot creates recovery debt and a memorable crooked silhouette.

keys.name: SECONDARY_LAG
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Torso restacks before the striking hand; front foot remains displaced.

keys.name: DISPLACED_SETTLE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root settles two cells forward of original stance; front foot stays far advanced.
keys.causal_role: Recovery debt remains visible instead of returning to idle.

keys.name: REENTRY_WITH_DEBT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Action eligibility returns without erasing displacement.
keys.causal_role: Re-entry is ready but not reset.

motion_dungeon.method: AUTHORED ASCII KEYS -> EXPLICIT HOLDS/TIMING -> DETERMINISTIC CONNECTIVE MOTION -> ASCII-ONLY FRAME RENDER -> MP4 -> SELF-CONTAINED SPA

rounds.highest_value_visible_defect: K5 CONTACT -> K6 LOCAL_REVERSAL_ROOT_OVERRUN read too much like a shortened straight reach; root overrun and self-compression were not visually violent enough.
rounds.concrete_correction: Pull the striking hand sharply back while driving pelvis/root farther through contact, widen front support, deepen K7/K8 fold/root drop, and preserve larger forward displacement through K13.

rounds.actual_render_inspection: PASS: K1 asymmetrical rear coil; K2 authored pelvis-before-hand bridge; K4 one-cell precontact gap; K5 explicit target contact/hit-stop hold; K6 striking hand reverses eight cells from contact while root continues five cells past K5 and support widens; K7/K8 body compression and catch; K9/K11 limb lag; K10 torso overshoot; K12/K13 displaced settle/reentry. No contact-at-farthest-reach recovery, reverse interpolation, idle reset, or generic un-authored causal bridge remains.

rounds.taste: Specific crooked coil -> spear-straight contact -> sudden hand snapback with pelvis overrun -> deep front-support collapse -> diagonal torso recoil.
rounds.function: The local limb clock visibly reverses before body/root inertia; support then catches the overrun and recovery pays shoulder/hand lag.
rounds.contempt: The body is left displaced and ugly-on-purpose after spending the strike; it does not politely restore the opening mannequin.
